answer: A payout is split so that 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The reef schedule is applied in haven and violet publishes each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1267 identities would post 618 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
